system.description: The Elder Sutra of Desire: One morning, the maiden awoke... Advanced students of the Sapphire Veil of Passion are among Creation's more careless fighters (and lovers), unconcerned with the consequences of their actions. This Charm may be activated when the martial artist successfully strikes an opponent with an unarmed attack, levying one of the following effects: � The martial artist immediately terminates the effects of all unnatural mental influence from which she suffers, transferring them to her target, who must then deal with them as he is best able. � The martial artist immediately terminates the effects of all Poison and Sickness effects from which she suffers, transferring them to her target.
system.source: Glories of the Most High: Maidens of Destiny
